blocks.html: The city of McKinney is located in northern Texas within Collin County. As Collin County’s third-largest city, McKinney is home to almost 200,000 people. McKinney is also the 16th most populous city in Texas and the third-fastest growing city in the United States in 2017. Since 1980, the population of McKinney has increased more than tenfold. The median household income in McKinney is just over $93,000, with property values exceeding $300,000. The current poverty rate in McKinney is almost 7%.

Dual-Diagnosis Treatment

blocks.html: At a dual diagnosis treatment program near McKinney, TX, treatment programs address addiction’s medical and underlying mental health challenges. It is not uncommon for someone with a drug or alcohol use disorder to have a mental health condition or vice versa. In fact, up to half of those who seek help to overcome a substance use disorder have a co-occurring mental health condition. In these cases, alcohol or drugs are used to self-medicate the often unpleasant symptoms related to physical or mental illness. This form of maladaptive coping often leads to chronic substance use and addiction. Without dual diagnosis treatment, one problem will remain unaddressed, and the risk of relapse increases significantly.
